title: The Nazca Crystal Skull & the Thoth Obelisk
fullTitle: February 28, 2025 — The Nazca Crystal Skull & the Thoth Obelisk
source: Interview transcript — Super Soldier Talk, "Alien Artifacts & Psionics in Mexico" with Sean Bond and Kosol Ouch
contentNote: This session includes claims about real, named living people (Sean Bond and James Rink) and about physical artifacts reported found in Mexico, presented as channeled and interpretive statements. Kosol Ouch's reading of the pictured stone obelisk is his own translation, given in the same session. The photograph was provided by the community.
